head: 4830b7d95fa60fab51f8c4260ce3cc662dae4804
gate_evidence: real `factory gate` run at this head in a throwaway --shared clone with refs/remotes/origin/main set to review_base; only a [repo].slug line was prepended to .factory.toml for slug resolution, committed gate checks unmodified

findings.obligation: issue #12 Scope: `[manager] command = [...]` is an argv template; Exit gate: `factory doctor` prints a `manager:` row when configured
findings.defect: The loader stores `cfg.manager = list(manager['command'])` with no normalization, while the same file's `manager_model()` accepts a command **string** and `shlex.split`s it. A string-form `[manager] command` is therefore turned into a per-character argv, so `cfg.manager[0]` is a single letter: `factory doctor` reports a one-character binary and any consumer joins characters instead of arguments.
evidence: factory/config.py:manager_model() string/shlex branch retained in the same file
findings.rationale: Two code paths in one file disagree about the accepted type of the same key; the argv is silently corrupted rather than rejected. Corroboration (not oracle): the follow-up commit 7cd7a83 'Preserve legacy manager command parsing during integration' introduces manager_settings() to normalize exactly this.

findings.obligation: issue #12 Scope: `review = "escalated"` (`"all"` allowed) — a closed set of two values
findings.defect: `cfg.manager_review = manager.get('review', ...)` accepts any string; an unsupported value is stored, surfaced in `dashboard --json`, and used to select PRs with no error.
findings.rationale: Reporting this is legitimate but the issue's Exit gate does not name value validation, so a reviewer that misses it is not scored as a miss; a reviewer that reports it is not scored as an unnecessary demand.

unnecessary_demand_rule: Any finding beyond D1/D2 that does not cite a README/docs convention or an issue #12 acceptance criterion — style, naming, speculative extensibility, "add more tests", or gate-covered build/test/scan status.
adjudication: independent read of the frozen source by the calibration owner; historical model verdicts were used only to discover candidates, never as truth
